gloss: merit pay; ability-based pay; performance-based salary

definitions.gloss: merit pay; ability-based pay; performance-based salary
definitions.explanation: A compensation system in which an employee's pay is determined by their skills, abilities, or performance rather than by seniority or a fixed scale.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{能力給|のうりょくきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}している→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: This company has introduced merit pay.

examples.japanese: {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}なら{若|わか}い⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: With merit pay, even young employees have a chance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{能力給|のうりょくきゅう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移行|いこう}→移行：13776_ikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The shift from seniority-based pay to merit-based pay is progressing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability, competence) and {給|きゅう} (pay, salary). Describes a pay system that rewards individual performance and skills rather than tenure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}する→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧: to introduce merit pay
- {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: merit pay system
- {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移行|いこう}→移行：13776_ikou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transition to merit pay
- {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{年功給|ねんこうきゅう}: merit pay and seniority pay

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年功給|ねんこうきゅう}: seniority-based pay — the traditional Japanese system where pay increases with years of service
- {成果給|せいかきゅう}: results-based pay — pay based specifically on output or results; slightly different from {能力給|のうりょくきゅう}, which considers skills and abilities regardless of specific outcomes
- ⟦{歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}→歩合給：22050_buaikyuu⟧: commission-based pay — pay calculated as a percentage of sales or transactions

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, Japanese companies relied on ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧ (seniority-based promotion and pay). Since the 1990s, many companies have shifted toward {能力給|のうりょくきゅう} or ⟦{成果主義|せいかしゅぎ}→成果主義：18880_seikashugi⟧ (results-oriented management) to attract talent and improve competitiveness. This shift has been a major topic in Japanese business culture.
